answer: Convex locked capital is the scarce resource: each identity locks units 60 days, recorded on a mirror ledger, weight being its lock squared over 10,000: 100 units yield weight 1. Splitting defeats itself, the square being per identity: 100 units split 100 ways leaves each lock worth 0.0001. Each epoch a gale nonce reaches all identities in one second; each lock-bound key must echo it signed inside that window; anyone recomputing weights from mirror and echo log zeroes a lock echoed under two keys. An honest agent locks 100 once, back in 60 days; 1,000 fakes lock 100,000 units at full weight.
